title: frame_audit_schema — post-generation continuity observation log (frame_audit/v1)
purpose: Complements prompt_continuity_lint (artifact 485ad4fc-b8d9-448c-a1ff-480361c27d8d). The linter verifies structural presence of rules R1–R4 before prompt submission. This schema records what an auditor actually observes in sampled stills after generation, covering the same four rules plus R-timing and R-orientation — the two categories the linter explicitly cannot reach. Together they separate pre-submission structural failure from post-generation model-compliance failure, a distinction the source article (art_01M68DNWCQ5SYGVT7KQXH69M0Y rev 1) observes but does not instrument.
execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
